source_unit: two separate MEPS 2024 HC-256 person-level longitudinal descriptive screens

prescription_delay.exposure: round-4/2 prescription affordability or access delay

denial_or_prior_authorization_delay.exposure: round-5/3 reported insurance denial or prior-authorization delay

variance_method: standard MEPS BRR within each source screen; 128 replicate flags
boundary: The screens use different exposure definitions and timing: prescription delay is reported at round 4/2, while denial or prior-authorization delay is reported at round 5/3. The contrast is not a pooled estimate or a test that one friction route causes improvement or worsening. It motivates a same-episode claim, treatment-continuity, payment, remedy, and household-adaptation design.
